countries.description: List of countries to retrieve OSM data for

include_relations.description: Additionally retrieve OSM route=power/power=circuit relations, so clean_osm_data can group their member ways into a single line matching the relation's real-world circuit

target_date.description: Optional historical date for data retrieval in ISO 8601 datetime format. Only honoured for retrieve.source: geofabrik.

overpass_api.description: Settings for retrieve_osm_overpass.py's own Overpass API client.

max_tries.description: Maximum number of attempts per query before giving up

user_agent.description: Identifies this tool to the Overpass API, per its fair-use policy.

project_name.description: Project name sent in the User-Agent header

email.description: Contact email sent in the User-Agent header

website.description: Project URL sent in the User-Agent header

network.description: Global assumptions for cleaning and connecting OSM grid features.

minimum_voltage_kv.description: Minimum nominal AC voltage retained from OSM, in kV

frequency_hz.description: AC/DC frequency in Hz, used to classify and normalise OSM ``frequency`` tags.

AC.description: AC frequency in Hz (50 for most of the world; 60 for the Americas and parts of Asia)

DC.description: Frequency tag value OSM uses to mark a DC line/converter

station_merge_radius_m.description: Buffer radius used to merge nearby substations and line endpoints, in metres

remove_under_construction.description: Whether assets tagged as under construction are dropped

remove_after.description: Exclude assets with a later planned start date; null disables this filter

additionalProperties.description: Optional country-specific overrides loaded from config/regions.

anyOf.description: Optional per-country AC/DC override; unset fields fall back to network.frequency_hz.

regions.description: Country-specific network overrides loaded from config/regions

crs.description: Coordinate reference systems used throughout clean_osm_data/build_osm_network.

geo.description: Geographic CRS used to store and exchange coordinates

distance.description: Equal-area/equal-distance CRS used for buffering and length calculations; must suit the geographic extent in use (the default, ETRS89-LAEA, covers Europe)
